study_identification_part.si_4_title: Lifespan Normative Models of White Matter Fractional Anisotropy: Applications to Early Psychosis

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study employed warped Bayesian linear regression (WBLR) with a third-order polynomial B-spline basis expansion over age (five evenly spaced knots) combined with a SinhArcsinh warping function to address non-Gaussian distributions. The PCNtoolkit was used for implementation.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we employed a warped Bayesian linear regression (BLR) model and used in previous research [4], [25]. This approach involved applying a third-order polynomial B-spline basis expansion over age, with five evenly spaced knots, combined with a SinhArcsinh warping function.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Cirstian2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Normative modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Fractional anisotropy (FA) values were extracted from 48 white matter tracts using DTI modeling on the lowest shell value. TBSS was used for registration and projection to standard space, and the JHU atlas was used for segmentation to compute mean FA values along the skeleton of each tract.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: we estimated the DTI model using DTIfit on the lowest shell value in order to extract the fractional anisotropy (FA) values. Following this, we ran Tract-Based Spatial Statistics (TBSS) [44] on the FA images... Finally, segmentation was conducted using the Johns Hopkins University (JHU) atlas [45]. This process delineated 48 white matter (WM) tracts... for which we computed the mean FA values along the skeleton of each tract.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Cirstian2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Data acquisition and processing

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model incorporated age (with a third-order polynomial B-spline basis expansion with five evenly spaced knots for non-linear effects), sex, dummy coded race, and site as covariates. The B-spline expansion enables capturing non-linear age trajectories across the lifespan.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: The model incorporated several covariates, including sex, age, and dummy coded race, and site.
